title: Headphones on a turntable
prompt: A matte black pair of over-ear headphones rotating slowly on a mirrored turntable, light sweeping across the ear cups. Static camera, product centred. 100 mm lens, one soft key light from the top left and a thin rim light behind, dark grey seamless backdrop. Clean, premium mood.
why: The product moves, the camera does not: a turntable rotation is a motion the model handles well, and 'static camera, product centred' replaces a negative prompt (Kling in UniqAI has no negative field).

title: Perfume bottle, macro water drop
prompt: A glass bottle of amber perfume standing on wet black slate, a single water drop running down the glass. Slow push in on the bottle. 90 mm macro lens, soft backlight through the liquid, small specular highlights. Elegant, quiet atmosphere.
why: One drop running down the glass is a single, slow, physically simple motion. Backlight through amber liquid gives the model a strong colour read on a dark surface.

title: Sneaker, quarter orbit
prompt: A white canvas sneaker on a light grey studio sweep, the fabric laces lifting and settling as a soft breeze passes. Slow quarter-turn orbit around the shoe, stable framing. 85 mm lens, bright even softbox light with a faint ground shadow. Fresh catalogue mood.
why: A quarter turn, not a full orbit, keeps the far side of the shoe out of the shot where models invent laces. The breeze on the laces is the secondary motion that makes it a video, not a slideshow.

title: Coffee pour, slow motion with sound
prompt: A ceramic cup on a wooden counter, espresso pouring into it in slow motion, crema forming on the surface. Static camera, close-up, cup centred. 100 mm macro lens, warm window light from the left, dark background. Audio: the pour, a soft clink of the cup, quiet café room tone. No music, no voices.
why: Slow pouring liquid is a flattering test for any model and Veo adds synced sound to it. Each audio element is listed explicitly; 'no voices' stops the model from adding chatter to a café scene.

title: Watch, two connected shots
prompt: Shot 1: a steel dive watch on wet black stone, water beading on the crystal, slow push in on the dial. Shot 2: cut to a close-up of the second hand ticking, light sweeping across the bezel. 90 mm macro lens, cool blue key light with a thin warm rim, dark background. Clean, premium mood.
why: Seedance advertises native multi-shot output, so the prompt labels the shots and keeps each one to a single motion. Both shots share the lens and lighting line so the cut feels like one commercial.

title: Skincare jar, slow rotate on marble
prompt: A frosted glass skincare jar with a white lid standing on a pale marble slab, rotating slowly on a hidden turntable, a soft highlight sliding across the frosted surface. Static camera, product centred, 45-degree angle from above. 85 mm lens, large soft light from the top right, gentle shadow, blurred eucalyptus leaves far behind. Calm, clean mood.
why: Frosted glass hides the fake reflections that clear glass invites. The '45-degree angle from above' line fixes the framing so the model does not drift to eye level mid-clip.
